# Axel Peter Kristensen

::: {.lede}
Sociologist and demographer with a PhD from the University of Oslo. I work quantitatively with large datasets, statistical analysis and data preparation, mostly register and survey data, mainly in R and Stata.
:::

My research has centred on population and family topics: fertility, gender equality, childlessness and partnerships, and how unemployment and economic uncertainty relate to family formation. I completed my PhD in January 2026 with the dissertation *Fertility Decline and Rising Childlessness: The Roles of Economic Uncertainty, Subjective Perceptions, and Social Parenting in Norway*, supervised by Trude Lappegård.

Alongside research I am an editorial assistant for the *European Journal of Population*. I am currently available for research and analysis positions, in and outside academia.
